title: The Universal Classifier for Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36302v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing and computer vision by leveraging universal vocabularies, Graph Machine Learning (GML) remains fractured due to the absence of a unified feature and structural representation across diverse domains. Existing works claiming to be Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) are typically restricted to node-level predictions or require fixed feature dimensions, failing to provide a truly task-agnostic backbone for the full spectrum of graph learning applications. In this paper, we introduce the Universal Classifier (UC), which supports arbitrary feature and class cardinalities, unifying node-, edge-, and graph-level objectives under a single similarity-based classification objective. The UC reformulates all node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction tasks as maximizing similarity in the latent space: by lifting heterogeneous features and labels into 3D latent tensors, the model learns

translated_title: 面向图学习的通用分类器
translated_abstract: 虽然基础模型通过利用通用词汇表彻底改变了自然语言处理和计算机视觉领域，但由于缺乏跨不同领域的统一特征和结构表示，图机器学习（GML）仍然处于割裂状态。现有声称是图基础模型（GFMs）的工作通常仅限于节点级预测，或需要固定的特征维度，未能为图学习应用的全谱提供真正与任务无关的骨干网络。在本文中，我们提出了通用分类器（UC），它支持任意的特征和类别数量，将节点级、边级和图级目标统一在单一的基于相似度的分类目标之下。UC将所有节点级、边级和图级预测任务重新表述为在潜在空间中最大化相似度：通过将异构特征和标签提升为3D潜在张量，模型学习……
tldr: 该论文提出通用分类器（UC），通过将异构特征和标签提升为3D潜在张量，把节点级、边级和图级预测任务统一为潜在空间中的相似度最大化问题，支持任意特征和类别数量，为图学习提供了真正任务无关的统一框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Universal Classifier (UC), which unifies node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction tasks as similarity maximization in latent space by lifting heterogeneous features and labels into 3D latent tensors, supporting arbitrary feature and class cardinalities for a truly task-agnostic graph learning backbone.
